## Highlights
### New
- Tab groups that extensions make, such as the tabs Claude works in, now appear on Mac as folders in the Space’s open tabs, in the group’s name and color. Renaming, recoloring, collapsing or deleting the folder, or moving tabs in or out, changes the group the extension sees, and the folder keeps following the group after Crest restarts.
### Fixed
- Extensions that sign you back in on their own when the browser starts, such as Claude, now stay signed in after Crest restarts on Mac, as they do in Chrome.
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.

## Highlights
### Fixed
- Downloads follow the Automatic Downloads choice of the site you’re on, including files it serves from another address, such as GitHub release files. A blocked download’s message no longer appears twice. - Chromium pages use your default zoom when they open and keep your chosen zoom as you navigate. - Chromium is updated to 154.0.8037.57 with upstream security and compatibility fixes.
